name: Tonfabrik
author: g0rst
tagline: a game that teaches kids how synthesizers work
description: Die Tonfabrik: a story game for children from 7. Inherit a sound factory, learn oscillator, VCA, envelope, filter, LFO, echo, sequencer and FM from Herr Vogl the woodpecker, rebuild sounds for customers, then play your own music in live mode.
